target_customer: Consumers shopping through a social or video home shopping style experience
problem: Home shopping was dominated by TV networks. Shopagram described itself as a next generation home shopping network, with few product details public.
business_model: E-commerce retail, revenue model not stated in sources

founders.name: Jamal Ashraf
founders.background_notes: The YC page gives no biography.

technical_complexity.rationale: A video and commerce app for a one person team used standard components, though no source describes the product.

defensibility.rationale: No source shows any proprietary supply, audience or technology.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source on any incumbent reaction to Shopagram.

market_need_then: No source documents demand for Shopagram. Established TV home shopping networks existed, per the YC description.

branding.domain_note: Used shopagram.co, not the .com, per the YC page.

brand_strength.rationale: A branding search found no coverage of the company. The name echoes Instagram and a later unrelated Shopify app also uses it.

outcome_analysis: Shopagram was a one person YC Winter 2014 company with a home shopping concept. No press, shutdown notice or cause is public, so the cause of failure is not public and failure factors stay empty. Two small seed amounts appear only in one database.
notes: Company site returned HTTP 503 in this session. Both seed amounts come from one database (Dealroom) with no dates or investors, and they may be one round counted twice or the YC deal. A dated competitor search found nothing from 2014, so the list is empty. The cause of shutdown is not public.
